responses.text: Not at all - they're my best customers. As long as you don't try to sell 'em chems or alcohol, they treat you fair.

topics.prompt: Is it dangerous to trade with the Legion?

responses.text: Between having to hire protection and getting slapped with taxes, it's more profitable to stick to Arizona and New Mexico.
But, I do cross the river from time to time when an opportunity comes along.

responses.text: I haven't had the pleasure. I have crossed paths with Legate Lanius, his second-in-command, however. It was... unpleasant.
